setup_boostbook_tools: run setup_boostbook to download and install DocBook XSL, DTD, and FOP tools for Boost documentation
download_and_verify_docbook_xsl: run setup_docbook_xsl to download, verify checksum, and extract DocBook XSLT stylesheets into a tools directory
download_and_verify_docbook_dtd: run setup_docbook_dtd to download, verify checksum, and extract DocBook XML DTD into a tools directory
adjust_user_config_jam: run adjust_user_config to modify user-config.jam with boostbook, xsltproc, doxygen, and fop tool paths
verify_file_checksum: run verify_checksum to validate a downloaded file against its expected SHA256 hash and exit on mismatch
